workflow_id: wf_ae_001
steps:
  - id: search_pending_pdfs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files"
      method: GET
      query:
        q: "'pending_articles_folder_id' in parents and mimeType='application/pdf'"
        fields: "files(id,name)"
      auth: google_oauth
    output: pdf_file_list

  - id: loop_pdf_files
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{pdf_file_list.files}}"
      iterator: pdf_file
    output: processed_articles

  - id: download_pdf_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{{pdf_file.id}}?alt=media"
      method: GET
      response_type: binary
      auth: google_oauth
    output: pdf_binary

  - id: send_to_ai_vision
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
      method: POST
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
        Authorization: "Bearer {{secrets.openai_api_key}}"
      body:
        model: "gpt-4o"
        messages:
          - role: system
            content: >
              You are a structured data extractor for an economics magazine.
              Extract article content from the provided PDF image(s).
              Return valid JSON with these fields: titulo (title), autor (author),
              seccion (section), bajada (lead), cuerpo (body text),
              destacados (highlighted quotes as array), recuadros (sidebars as array).
              If the PDF contains multiple book reviews, set es_multiple to true
              and return an array of articles under "articulos".
              For single articles, set es_multiple to false.
              Replace any double quotes inside text content with single quotes.
              The bajada (lead) field must never be empty; if not found,
              use the first sentence of the body.
          - role: user
            content:
              - type: image_url
                image_url:
                  url: "data:application/pdf;base64,{{pdf_binary.base64}}"
        max_tokens: 4096
    output: ai_raw_response

  - id: extract_ai_content
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{ai_raw_response}}"
      field: "choices[0].message.content"
    output: raw_content_string

  - id: strip_markdown_fences
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{raw_content_string}}"
      operations:
        - type: regex_replace
          pattern: "^```(?:json)?\\n?"
          replacement: ""
        - type: regex_replace
          pattern: "\\n?```$"
          replacement: ""
    output: clean_json_string

  - id: replace_double_quotes_in_content
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{clean_json_string}}"
      operations:
        - type: string_replace
          target: '\\"'
          replacement: "'"
    output: sanitized_json_string

  - id: parse_extracted_json
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{sanitized_json_string}}"
      operations:
        - type: parse_json
    output: extracted_article

  - id: validate_required_fields
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      data: "{{extracted_article}}"
      required_fields:
        - titulo
        - seccion
        - cuerpo
      rules:
        - field: bajada
          condition: not_empty
          fallback: "{{extracted_article.cuerpo | first_sentence}}"
    output: validated_article

  - id: handle_validation_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_step: validate_required_fields
      action: log_and_continue
      message: "Validation failed for PDF {{pdf_file.name}}: missing required fields"

  - id: log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: article_extracted
      details:
        file_name: "{{pdf_file.name}}"
        file_id: "{{pdf_file.id}}"
        es_multiple: "{{validated_article.es_multiple}}"
        title: "{{validated_article.titulo}}"
    output: audit_record

workflow_id: wf_lf_004

    op: write_database
    params:

        - "/index.html"

    output: precache_result

  - id: intercept_fetch_request
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "event.type == 'fetch'"
      source: service_worker
    output: intercepted_request

  - id: check_llm_cleanup_bypass
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: intercepted_request
      condition: "request.url matches '/api/llm-cleanup'"
    output: llm_cleanup_requests

  - id: route_request_strategy
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      conditions:
        - when: "llm_cleanup_requests is not empty"
          goto: network_only_fetch
        - default: cache_first_lookup
    output: routing_decision

  - id: network_only_fetch
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      url: "{{intercepted_request.url}}"
      method: "{{intercepted_request.method}}"
      headers: "{{intercepted_request.headers}}"
      cache_policy: network_only
    output: network_only_response

  - id: cache_first_lookup
    op: read_database
    params:
      source: service_worker_cache
      key: "{{intercepted_request.url}}"
    output: cache_lookup_result

  - id: evaluate_cache_hit
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "cache_lookup_result.found == true"
      on_true: serve_cached_response
      on_false: fallback_network_fetch
    output: cache_hit_decision

  - id: serve_cached_response
    op: format_output
    params:
      source: cache_lookup_result.data
      content_type: "{{cache_lookup_result.content_type}}"
      status: 200
    output: cached_response

  - id: fallback_network_fetch
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      url: "{{intercepted_request.url}}"
      method: "{{intercepted_request.method}}"
      headers: "{{intercepted_request.headers}}"
    output: network_response

  - id: update_cache_on_fetch
    op: write_database
    params:
      target: service_worker_cache
      key: "{{intercepted_request.url}}"
      value: "{{network_response}}"
      condition: "network_response.status == 200"
    output: cache_update_result

  - id: handle_offline_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      watch_steps:
        - fallback_network_fetch
      on_error:
        action: serve_offline_fallback
        fallback_asset: "/offline.html"
    output: error_handling_result

  - id: log_cache_event
    op: log_audit
    params:
      event_type: pwa_cache_event
      details:
        request_url: "{{intercepted_request.url}}"
        served_from: "{{cache_hit_decision}}"
        precache_status: "{{precache_result.status}}"
    output: audit_log_entry
